test_title: PYST 50: SSC CPO - Quantitative Aptitude (Held on 03 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: A can do a piece of work in 8 days, while B can do it in 7 days. If they work at it alternately beginning with A, then in how many days will the work be completed?
solution:
**Given:**

A can do a piece of work in 8 days

B can do the same work in 7 days

**Concept Used:**

Total work = Efficiency × Time

**Calculation:**

Total work = LCM of (8, 7) = 56 unit

Efficiency of A = 56 / 8 = 7 unit / day

Efficiency of B = 56 / 7 = 8
